resources.string: "Pausing creates a break in the saved track, so stopped time is not joined by a straight line."
"Progress vibration is off by default. Set it in Advanced to buzz at a distance or active-time interval."
"Recalibration needs Orientation provider set to Custom sensors."

"Recommended setup: Google Fused.

Quick test: stand still, face a clear landmark, then switch North-up / Compass.
The map should keep the same direction and should not jump after open or wake.

North reference:
Google Fused chooses it automatically.
With Custom sensors, use True north for maps,
or Magnetic north to match a magnetic compass.

If Google Fused still feels wrong on your watch,
switch Orientation provider to Custom sensors.
Custom mode prefers Rotation vector when available,
and gives you Recalibrate Compass, source test,
heading source selection, and accuracy-color options."
